licence.renewsTogether.value: Lease or occupation licence agreement, renewed with TECOM leasing before the licence. The Establishment Card from GDRFA Dubai has the same expiry as the licence and is renewed after it; GDRFA sends no reminder. Third party liability and workmen's compensation insurance for visa employees at lease renewal. TECOM leasing starts lease termination if the lease is not renewed. The AXS counter for lease renewal is in Dubai Knowledge Park, Block 8.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai Knowledge Park, renews together (in5 (TECOM) renewal note dated 2020, an operator document, REPORTED); https://infive.ae/setup/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/Renewal-Process-Notes.pdf

licence.afterExpiry.value: If the licence is not renewed on or before expiry, a late renewal penalty is added to the next year's fee and rises in steps after more than 30, 60 and 90 days. No grace period is stated. DDA may refuse to renew the licence and may refuse government services, including visa sponsorship. DDA may suspend, revoke or cancel a licence by written notice if renewal fees or late renewal penalties are unpaid, with no fixed day count. A company in breach, including by ceasing business in the zone, can be deregistered and struck off three months after a written notice unless it gives a reasonable justification. No automatic termination at a fixed number of days after expiry was found.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai Knowledge Park, late renewal (DDA Decision No. 1 of 2021 Schedule 4; Licensing Regulations 2003 reg 10.1.5; Private Companies Regulations 2016 reg 100 (companies; branches follow a separate process); CONFIRMED. Decision 1/2021 is the latest listed on the DDA legal database; a later amendment could not be ruled out); https://dda.gov.ae/-/media/67662280247F46F2B94A853943F014C4.pdf ; https://dda.gov.ae/-/media/07DE5215EC064FC990A6D5965955BD79.pdf ; https://dda.gov.ae/-/media/7342AF827E3643E68CAE10D72C883146.pdf ; https://dda.gov.ae/en/legal-database/laws-and-regulations

value.consequence: More than 30 days after expiry: the late renewal penalty rises a step.
More than 60 days after expiry: the late renewal penalty rises a step.
More than 90 days after expiry: the late renewal penalty rises a step. This is a penalty step only, not a termination date.
